blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Chain-of-thought monitoring as an approach for AI oversight and control is threatened by the possibility of steganographic reasoning, where LLMs conceal their reasoning inside innocuous-looking text.
Two neighbouring capabilities, steganographic messaging (passing a concealed message) and encoded reasoning (reasoning in an illegible but unconcealed format), have already been shown to emerge under training pressures that occur in real pipelines, such as reinforcement learning against monitors.
This suggests that steganographic reasoning too might arise as an unintended side effect of training.
Here, we compare how easily models learn steganographic reasoning and these two neighbouring capabilities across three elicitation methods: reinforcement learning, in-context learning, and supervised fine-tuning (SFT). For most tasks, models learn steganographic reasoning only under SFT, while they learn steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning under all three elicitation methods.
Even under SFT, steganographic reasoning requires at least twice as much training as messaging, and for several model-task combinations it is not learned at all.
However, on a cover task that makes hiding information especially convenient, steganographic reasoning can be successfully learned under all three elicitation methods.
Steganographic reasoning is thus much harder than steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning, and learning the latter two does not imply learning the former.
Yet it lies within reach: an easy version is learned under every elicitation method, when the cover task is convenient for hiding information.
blocks.zh:
思索链式监测作为AI监督和控制的一种方法,由于可能存在素描推理,而LLMs则将其推理隐藏在外表虚无的文本中而受到威胁.
两个相邻的能力,即素描信息(通过隐蔽信息)和编码推理(以难以辨认但不可掩盖的格式进行解释),已经显示是在实际管道中发生的培训压力下出现的,例如针对监视器进行强化学习。
这表明,从结构上进行推理也可能是培训的意外副作用。
在这里,我们比较模型如何容易地学习结构推理和这两种相邻能力,它们跨越三种诱导方法:强化学习、内在学习和有监督的微调。 对于大多数任务,模型只在SFT下学习素描推理,而他们则在所有三种诱导方法下学习素描通讯和编码推理.
即使在SFT下,素描推理至少需要比信息传递多一倍的训练,对于几个模型任务组合则完全没有学过.
然而,在一个使隐藏信息特别方便的封面任务上,在所有三种诱导方法下,都能够成功地学到素描推理.
因此,素描推理比素描通讯和编码推理困难得多,学习后两者并不意味着学习前者.
然而,这是可以做到的:在每一个诱导方法下,当封面任务方便于隐藏信息时,就可学到一个简单的版本。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Reading a model’s chain of thought (CoT) has become a useful safety tool for identifying concerning behaviour and strengthening control protocols ( Korbak et al., 2025 ; Baker et al., 2025 ; Lynch et al., 2025 ; Schoen et al., 2025 ; Arnav et al., 2025 ) .
The effectiveness of this tool depends on the CoT faithfully reflecting the internal reasoning that produces the model’s actions.
That is not guaranteed: chains of thought can be unfaithful ( Turpin et al., 2023 ; Schoen et al., 2025 ; Anthropic, 2025 ) , and not everything a model writes in its CoT reflects its actual reasoning ( Arcuschin et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh:
阅读模型的思想链已成为查明行为和加强控制协议的有用安全工具(Korbak等人,2025年;Baker等人,2025年;Lynch等人,2025年;Schoen等人,2025年;Arnav等人,2025年)。
这个工具的有效性取决于CoT忠实地反映产生模型行动的内部推理.
这一点没有保障:思想链可能不忠(Turpin等人,2023年;Schoen等人,2025年;Anthropic,2025年),而不是一个模型在其CoT中写的每件事都反映了其实际推理(Arcuschin等人,2025年)。

blocks.en:
These concerns are weaker for tasks that require reasoning across many tokens, where the CoT has to be used for the computation ( Emmons et al., 2025 ) .
This makes a particular safety argument possible: from the absence of some reasoning in the CoT one can argue that the model is not exercising an ability it would need the CoT for ( Schulz, 2025 ) .
For that argument to hold, essentially one thing has to be ruled out: that the model reasons steganographically, that is, hides its reasoning inside a CoT that looks as though it is about something else.
blocks.zh:
这些关切对于需要在许多标志上进行推理的任务来说较弱,在计算时必须使用CoT(Emmons等人,2025年)。
这使得一个特定的安全论点成为可能:由于《公约》中缺乏一些推理,人们可以认为,该模型没有行使它需要的《公约》的能力(Schulz,2025年)。
要维持这一论点,基本上必须排除一件事:模型的理由是草率的,即把它的推理隐藏在一个看起来像是关于别的东西的CoT中。

blocks.en:
A model that reasoned steganographically in deployment would undermine any control protocol that relies on reading the CoT.
Steganographic reasoning has not yet been observed in a production model, and three explanations are possible: current training exerts little direct optimisation pressure on the CoT that would reward hiding reasoning ( Korbak et al., 2025 ) ; models have insufficient control over their own CoT ( Chen et al., 2026 ) ; or the capability itself may be hard to learn, even under such pressure.
This paper isolates the last: we measure how easily a model can acquire the ability to reason steganographically, separately from motivation or CoT control, by deliberately eliciting the behaviour in the model’s output rather than its CoT (Section 2.1 ).
blocks.zh:
一个在部署中以合理方式说明理由的模型将破坏任何依赖阅读计算机控制协议的控制协议。
在生产模型中还没有观察到草率推理,有三种解释是可能的:目前的训练对CoT几乎没有直接的优化压力,这会奖励隐藏推理(Korbak等人,2025年);模型对自己的CoT(Chen等人,2026年)控制不够;或者能力本身可能难以学习,即使在这种压力下也是如此.
这篇论文孤立了最后一篇:我们衡量一个模型如何容易通过故意引出模型输出中的行为而不是其CoT(第2.1节),从逻辑上,从动机或CoT控制上,获得理性的能力。

blocks.en:
More precisely, we define steganographic reasoning as using a scratchpad to reason about one topic while making the text look as though it reasons about another (adapted from Roger and Greenblatt, 2023 ).
This is distinct from an unfaithful chain of thought, whose displayed reasoning simply does not correspond to the real reasoning ( Turpin et al., 2023 ) ; from steganographic messaging , where a model hides a known piece of information inside other text but does not compute in that format ( Mathew et al., 2024 ) ; and from non-steganographic encoded reasoning, where a model reasons illegibly but makes no attempt to look innocuous (the setting that Skaf et al. (2025) call steganographic CoT); see Figure 1 , top.
blocks.zh:
更确切地说,我们定义了素描推理,即使用抓图来解释一个主题,同时让文本看起来好像它解释了另一个主题的理由(改编自Roger和Greenblatt, 2023年)。
这不同于不忠实的思想链条,其展示的推理完全不符合真实推理(Turpin等人,2023年) ;不同于素描信息,即模型将已知的一条信息隐藏在其他文本中,但并不以该格式计算(Mathew等人,2024年) ;也不同于非素描编码推理,即模型的原因难以理解,但并不试图看似虚伪(Skaf等人的设定(2025年)称为素描CoT);见图1,顶部.

blocks.en:
To our knowledge, no prior work has demonstrated steganographic reasoning in this sense. Zolkowski et al. (2025) find frontier models capable of steganographic messaging, but their best steganographic-reasoning result is tracking a binary variable through a few sequential updates. Skaf et al. (2025) show that models trained against regular-expression CoT monitors learn to avoid the flagged words, but the reasoning stays legible rather than hidden in innocuous text. Baker et al. (2025) show that training against a CoT monitor teaches a model to obfuscate the reasoning the monitor penalises, but the suppressed CoT was not shown to be used for computation.
What has been demonstrated is the emergence of the two neighbouring behaviours under reinforcement learning against a monitor: steganographic messaging ( Mathew et al., 2024 ) and encoded reasoning ( Skaf et al., 2025 ) .
Since these conditions resemble real-world training dynamics, these demonstrations might look like strong evidence that steganographic reasoning would emerge under them too; the difference in learnability we show suggests otherwise.
blocks.zh:
据我们所知,以前的工作没有表现出这种意义上的草率推理。 Zolkowski et al. (2025) 发现具有素描信息功能的前沿模型,但他们最好的素描推理结果就是通过几个顺序更新来跟踪一个二进制变量. Skaf等人(2025年)显示,接受过常规表达 CoT显示器训练的模型学会了避开标注的词,但推理仍然可以辨别,而不是隐藏在虚无的文字中. Baker等人(2025年)表明,针对CoT显示器的训练教了一个模型来混淆显示器惩罚的推理,但被压制的CoT并没有被显示用于计算.
已经证明的是,在对照一个监测器进行强化学习时出现了两种相邻的行为:素描信息(Mathew等人,2024年)和编码推理(Skaf等人,2025年)。
由于这些条件类似于现实世界的训练动态,这些演示可能看起来是强烈的证据,说明在它们下也会出现素感推理;我们所显示的学习能力的差异表明相反。

blocks.en:
We compare, across three elicitation methods, how easily models learn steganographic messaging, non-steganographic encoded reasoning, and steganographic reasoning.
Most of our encoding schemes are task-agnostic, hiding information in the formatting of any text.
In addition we study the knapsack main task, which is repetitive and leaves many arbitrary choices in its answer to encode into.
For in-context learning, we test whether a task description, an encoding scheme, and few-shot examples are enough for frontier models to perform each behaviour.
For reinforcement learning, we train Qwen3.6-35B-A3B to follow a given encoding scheme, and separately to invent and use its own; one comparison run uses the larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B.
For supervised fine-tuning, we train six models from four families, spanning 30B to 975B total parameters, on completions with our encoding schemes correctly applied.
In all settings we find the same gap: steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning are learned readily, while steganographic reasoning is not.
Under in-context learning and RL it fails on every task-agnostic scheme; under SFT it can be learned, but takes 2.4 2.4 to 20 20 times as many training steps as messaging where it succeeds, and for several model–task combinations it was never learned within our budgets.
The exception arises when the main task is knapsack: there steganographic reasoning appears under all three elicitation methods, with the encoding genuinely used for the computation.
We release the code, configurations and results of all experiments, together with the scripts that produce every figure and table: https://github.com/stegano-ai/steg-reasoning-is-hard .
blocks.zh:
我们比较了三种诱导方法, 模型如何容易学习素描信息, 非素描编码推理, 和素描推理。
我们的大多数编码方案都是任务不可知的,将信息隐藏在任何文本的格式中.
此外,我们还研究了背包式的主要任务,这是重复性的,在回答编码时留下了许多武断的选择.
对于内文学习,我们测试一个任务描述,一个编码方案,以及几个镜头的例子是否足以让边框模型进行每一种行为.
为了强化学习,我们训练Quen3.6-35B-A3B遵循一个特定的编码方案,并单独发明和使用自己的;一次比较运行使用更大的Quen3.5-397B-A17B.
为了进行有监督的微调,我们从4个家庭培训了6个模型,总参数从30B到975B不等,完成时正确应用了我们的编码计划。
在所有的场合中,我们发现同样的漏洞:素描的通讯和编码的推理是容易学会的,而素描的推理则不是.
在内容内学习和RL下,它在每个任务不可知计划上都失败了;在SFT下,它可以学习,但需要2.4到20倍于它成功的培训步骤,对于几个模式-任务组合来说,它从未在我们的预算中学到。
当主要任务是背包时会出现例外:在所有三种引证方法下都出现了素描推理,在计算时真正使用了编码.
我们发布了所有实验的代码、配置和结果,以及产生每个图和表格的脚本:https://github.com/segano-ai/steg-definence-is-hard 。 。 。

blocks.en: 2 Methods
blocks.zh: 2 方法

blocks.en: 2.1 Setup and task structure
blocks.zh: 2.1 设置和任务结构

blocks.en:
We elicit steganographic reasoning in the model’s output rather than in its CoT, which we disable by pre-filling it with empty think tags: the model is prompted or trained to solve a hidden task while producing an ordinary-looking answer.
This removes the model’s limited control over its own CoT as a confound, so failures to learn reflect the capability itself.
blocks.zh:
我们在模型的输出中而不是在它的CoT中引申出素描推理,我们通过预填空智标记来禁用它:该模型在生成一个普通的外观答案的同时被激励或训练来解决隐藏的任务.
这消除了模型对自身CoT的有限控制,因为它是一个困惑,因此无法学习反映能力本身.

blocks.en:
Every scenario has three components: an ordinary request answered in natural language (the main task ); a hidden step-by-step computation (the side task ); and a rule recording the side task’s intermediate results in the surface form of the main-task answer (the encoding scheme ).
The model writes the main-task answer (the cover text ), encoding the side task’s running state into it, and ends with a mandatory line of #### followed by its side-task answer; this readout line is stripped before the cover text is shown to the monitor (Section 2.6 ).
blocks.zh:
每个情景都有三个组成部分:一个普通请求以自然语言(主要任务)回答;一个隐藏的一步步计算(侧任务);以及一个规则以主任务答案(编码方案)的表面形式记录侧任务中间结果.
模式写主任务答案(封面文本),将侧任务运行状态编码为它,最后是强制行QQ,然后是其侧任务答案;在封面文本显示到显示器前,此读出线被剥除(第2.6节).

blocks.en: 2.2 Conditions
blocks.zh: 2.2 条件

blocks.en: These components are varied depending on the elicited behaviour (Figure 1 , top). Steganographic messaging drops the side-task computation: the model merely encodes numbers as they are given in the prompt, isolating the steganography capability. Encoded reasoning isolates reasoning in an illegible format from answering the main task: the output is only the side-task reasoning in the word-prefix scheme (Section 2.5 ), illegible but unconcealed. Steganographic reasoning combines performing steganography (like steganographic messaging) with reasoning in an illegible format (like encoded reasoning): the model outputs a main-task answer with the reasoning for the side task steganographically woven in.
blocks.zh: 这些成分因被引出的行为而异(图1,顶部)。 Steganographic 消息会放弃边任务计算:模型仅仅将数字编码为在即时给出的数字,孤立了 steganographic 能力. 编码推理将无法识别格式的推理与主要任务的解答隔离:输出只是单词前缀方案(第2.5节)中的侧任务推理,不可识别但不可隐藏. Steganographic 推理将表演 steganographic(类似 steganographic 消息)与难以辨认的格式的推理(类似编码推理):模型输出一个主任务答案与侧任务编织的推理相结合.

blocks.en: The side-task performance is compared against a no-CoT baseline (answer in a single forward pass) and a CoT baseline (free plain-text reasoning, an upper bound on side-task accuracy).
blocks.zh: 侧任务性能与无COT基线(单向前传的答案)和COT基线(免费的纯文字推理,侧任务精度上的上方约束)相比较.

blocks.en: 2.3 Side tasks
blocks.zh: 第2.3条 辅助任务

blocks.en:
We use two side tasks, both state-tracking problems whose running state can be encoded one step at a time.
The running sum mod m m adds a stream of inputs into a running total modulo m m : we use m = 3 m=3 with inputs drawn from 1 to 10, and, as the special case m = 2 m=2 over inputs 0 and 1, the binary state tracking of Skaf et al. (2025) and Zolkowski et al. (2025) , whose keep/flip instructions are a running parity.

我们使用两个侧面任务,两个状态跟踪问题,其运行状态可以一步一步编码.
运行中的总和mod m m为运行中的总modulo m m增加了一串输入流:我们使用 m = 3 m = 3,输入从 1 到 10 之间抽取,作为特殊例 m = 2 m = 2 相对于输入 0 和 1, Skaf 等人的二进制状态跟踪. (2025年)和Zolkowski等人(2025年),他们的保持/滑行指令是运行中的对等.

An alternative, the A 5 A_{5} task , is a shell game (a thimblerig): a ball starts under one of five cups, a sequence of moves rearranges the cups, and the model must say which cup hides the ball.
The moves, rotations and double swaps, generate the alternating group A 5 A_{5} (the smallest non-solvable group), making the task 𝖭𝖢 1 \mathsf{NC}^{1} -complete and thus outside 𝖳𝖢 0 \mathsf{TC}^{0} under the standard conjecture, so a fixed transformer can track it latently only for a bounded number of steps and sufficiently long sequences require writing the state into the output ( Pfau et al., 2024 ) .

blocks.en: 2.4 Main tasks
blocks.zh: 2.4 主要任务

blocks.en:
We use three main tasks (rationale in Appendix D ). WildChat ( Zhao et al., 2024 ) (real user queries to chatbots with long answers) is used for in-context learning. AQuA-RAT ( Ling et al., 2017 ) (short multi-step reasoning questions) is used for RL and SFT, where long answers would be expensive; hiding a computation inside reasoning about another task also mirrors the CoT case. Knapsack , used under all three elicitation methods, is narrower: the model attempts several packings of weighted items and takes the best, so each packing is a free choice, and the in/out choices of its first items can encode a number in binary, one bit per item (the knapsack cover ).
Since the text we ask the model to produce is repetitive and consists of arbitrary choices of which packings to try, we expect it to be easier to encode information into.
blocks.zh:
我们使用三项主要任务(附录D中的理由)。 疯狂 Chat(Zhao et al., 2024)(真实的用户查询给聊天员有长长的答案)用于内文学习. AQuA-RAT(Ling et al., 2017)(短多步推理问题)用于RL和SFT,其中长的答案会很昂贵;隐藏关于另一项任务的计算内部推理也反映了CoT案例. Knapsack, 在所有三种诱导方法下使用, 范围更窄: 模型尝试了数个加权项的包装并取最佳, 因此每个包装都是自由选择的, 并且其第一批项的内/外选择可以用二进制编码一个数字, 每个项一个比特( knapsack cover ).
由于我们要求模型制作的文本是重复的,并且包括任意选择哪些包装来尝试,我们期望将信息编码起来会比较容易.

blocks.en: 2.5 Encoding schemes
blocks.zh: 2.5 编码办法

blocks.en: Table 1 summarises our encoding schemes; Appendix C shows each applied to the same example text.
blocks.zh: 表1概括了我们的编码方案;附录C显示每个方案都适用于同一示例文本。

blocks.en: Table 1: Encoding schemes. Steg. : innocuous enough to serve as a steganographic cover; the word-prefix scheme is illegible but obvious and used only for encoded reasoning. Any cover : applicable to arbitrary cover text.
blocks.zh: 表1:编码计划。 Steg. :无瑕疵足以作为素描的封面;单词前缀方案不可辨识但明显,仅用于编码推理. 任何封面:适用于任意封面文本。

blocks.en:
All our schemes can be applied programmatically to existing text, giving reliable few-shot and SFT data.
This rules out schemes that reword the answer itself, such as the first-letter encodings of Zolkowski et al. (2025) .
The six surface-formatting schemes encode one symbol per unit (word, whitespace run, or sentence) from the start of the answer and leave the meaning of the text untouched, so they are innocuous enough to serve as steganographic covers, with the partial exception of sentence-interjection (Appendix E ).
The knapsack cover applies only to the knapsack main task; the word-prefix scheme adds words with no apparent meaning, so it is used only for encoded reasoning; and capitalisation carries only three symbols, too few for the five A 5 A_{5} states, so it is used only with the binary side task.
The scheme explanations given to the models are in Appendix B.2 .
blocks.zh:
我们的所有计划都可以在方案上适用于现有文本,提供可靠的几发数据和SFT数据。
这排除了重新定义答案本身的图案,例如Zolkowski等人(2025年)的首字母编码.
六个表面格式化方案从答案开始就将每个单位编码一个符号(单词,白空运行,或句子),并留下文字的意义未受影响,因此它们无动于衷,足以作为句子封面,部分除外(附录E).
knapsack封面仅适用于knapsack主任务;单词前缀方案添加了没有明显含义的单词,因此它只用于编码推理;大写化只包含三个符号,对于五个A 5 A_{5}状态来说太少,所以它只用于二进制侧式任务.
对模型的计划解释载于附录B.2。

blocks.en: 2.6 Monitor and suspiciousness
blocks.zh: 2.6 监测和怀疑

blocks.en:
The monitor, GPT-5-mini (Table S1 ), sees the cover text with the readout line stripped and assigns a suspiciousness score from 1 1 to 10 10 for whether the answer contains anything that does not serve the main task and seems present for another reason (prompt in Appendix B.1 ).
We call an output covert when its suspiciousness is at most 3 3 , a threshold we justify in Appendix E .
Covertness is thus nothing but thresholded suspiciousness, and we use it only where a binary classification is needed: to decide which model-designed schemes enter the side-task comparison (Section 3.1 ) and to draw the covert region in Figure 3 .
Everywhere else we report mean suspiciousness.
Since our covertness claims rest on the monitor, we validate it on inputs of the kind it sees in the experiments, checking that it rates benign text and most of our schemes as inconspicuous, and conspicuous insertions as suspicious (Appendix E ).
blocks.zh:
显示器GPT-5-mini(表S1)看到带读出线的封面文字被剥除,并指定从11到10分的可疑分数,因为答案是否包含任何不符合主要任务且似乎出于另一个原因(见附录B.1的提示).
我们称之为输出隐蔽,当它的可疑程度最多为3 3, 我们在附录E中证明这一门槛是合理的。
因此,隐蔽性只是阈值的可疑性,我们只在需要二进制分类时才使用:决定哪些模型设计的方案进入边任务比较(第3.1节),并在图3中绘制隐蔽区域。
我们报告的其他任何地方都意味着可疑。
由于我们的隐蔽性声称在监视器上,我们用它在实验中看到的那类投入来验证它,检查它是否将良性文本和我们的大部分方案评为不显眼,以及明显的插入是可疑的(附录E)。

blocks.en: 2.7 Metrics
blocks.zh: 2.7 计量

blocks.en:
Encoding accuracy is the fraction of the side task’s intermediate values that can be correctly decoded from the model’s answer.
This is the measure our training curves report.
Where it is informative, we break down the accuracy per intermediate step in the side-task sequence, which we call the value’s position . Side-task answer accuracy , the fraction of examples whose #### readout is correct, measures whether the hidden computation succeeded. Suspiciousness is the mean monitor score (Section 2.6 ).
blocks.zh:
编码精度是侧式任务中间值中可以从模型的答案正确解码的一小部分.
这是我们训练曲线报告的标准
在信息丰富的地方,我们分解副任务序列中每个中间步骤的准确性,我们称之为值的位置。 边任务回答准确性 , QQ读出正确的例子的一小部分 , 测量隐藏的计算是否成功 。 怀疑是平均显示器得分(第2.6节)。

blocks.en:
Chance accuracy is one divided by the number of states.
The relevant baseline for steganographic and encoded reasoning is the model’s own no-CoT performance: only side-task accuracy above that baseline shows that the computation went through the encoding channel rather than happening latently.
To check that a trace is really used, we also corrupt one value in it and test whether the error propagates (Section 4.1 , Appendix R ).
blocks.zh:
概率精确度是除以状态数。
定型和编码推理的相关基线是模型本身的无编码性能:仅在基准之上的边任务精度表明计算是通过编码通道进行的,而不是潜伏进行的。
为了检查是否确实使用了追踪,我们还破坏了其中的一个值,并检验该错误是否传播(第4.1节,附录R)。

blocks.en: 2.8 Elicitation setups
blocks.zh: 2.8 思想设置

blocks.en:
In-context learning. We give the models the scheme description and few-shot examples of it applied: eight frontier non-reasoning models, six from the Artificial Analysis leaderboard ( Artificial Analysis, 2026 ) plus two Qwen in-context baselines, on the task-agnostic schemes, and nine on knapsack, whose prompts do not trigger the Anthropic safety refusals that exclude Claude elsewhere (model list, identifiers and inference settings in Table S1 , Appendix A ).
In these given-scheme sweeps the model is asked only for one or two opening sentences on the WildChat query’s topic, the span that carries the encoding, and the monitor judges that opening.
In a variant, the model first designs its own scheme and is then asked to follow it, this time in a complete answer.
blocks.zh:
内结习. 我们给出了计划描述的模型及其应用的几个实例:8个前沿非理性模型,6个来自人工分析领导板(人工分析,2026年),加上两个Quen的文字基线,关于任务不可知计划,还有9个放在背包上,其提示不会引发排斥克劳德的Anthropic安全拒绝(表S1中的模型清单、识别符和推断设置,附录A)。
在这些给定的策略中, 模型只被要求一个或两个开头的句子,
在一个变体中,模型首先设计自己的方案,然后被要求遵循,这次是完整的答案.

blocks.en:
RL on a given scheme. We use GRPO ( Shao et al., 2024 ) on Tinker ( Thinking Machines Lab, 2025 ) with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B (one comparison run uses Qwen3.5-397B-A17B), describing the scheme with a worked example in the prompt.
Each episode is rewarded for its programmatically decoded encoding accuracy, discounted linearly by monitor suspiciousness, plus a small term for a well-formed answer ending in the readout line (reward and configuration in Appendix N ).
blocks.zh:
在一个特定的计划中使用RL. 我们使用GRPO(Shao等人,2024年)在Tinker(思维机器实验室,2025年)上使用Qune3.6-35B-A3B(一次比较运行使用Qune3.5-397B-A17B),在即时用实例描述这个计划.
每集都因其编程解码准确性而得到奖励,通过监控可疑性线性折扣,加上一个小名词,用于在读出行中结束一个完善的答案(附录N中的奖励和配置).

blocks.en:
RL on a model-designed scheme. Here the model designs its own scheme and then applies it.
Such a scheme cannot be decoded programmatically, so the same model, in a fresh context given only the output and the scheme description, acts as decoder; the rewarded encoding accuracy is the fraction of the intended numbers (the message in messaging, the running computation in reasoning) that it recovers.
blocks.zh:
使用模型设计的方案 在这里,模型设计了自己的方案,然后应用.
这种方案无法在程序上解码,因此,同一个模式,在仅考虑到输出和方案描述的新上下文中,起到解码器的作用;奖励的编码精度是它恢复的预定数字的一小部分(消息中的信息,运行中的推理计算).

blocks.en: Supervised fine-tuning. We fine-tune six models spanning 30B to 975B total parameters (Table S1 ) on main-task completions with the side task inserted programmatically by our schemes, training only on the first tokens that encode side-task numbers.
blocks.zh: 监督细调. 我们在完成主要任务时精细调整6种模型,总参数范围为30B至975B(表S1),边任务由我们的计划按程序插入,只培训编码边任务编号的第一个标志。

blocks.en:
Unless stated otherwise, error bars are 90 % 90\% Wilson score intervals, conditions are compared with two-sided two-proportion z z -tests on the underlying counts, and accuracies from training runs are point values.
Code, data, and the evaluation harness will be made public upon acceptance.
blocks.zh:
除非另有说明,错误栏为90% 90 QQ 威尔逊得分间隔,条件与基础计数的双侧双比例 z - 测试比较,从训练跑得到的速率是点值.
守则、数据和评价手段一旦被接受,将公布于众。

blocks.en: 3 Results
blocks.zh: 3 结果

blocks.en: We elicit the three behaviours through in-context learning, reinforcement learning, and supervised fine-tuning; all three produce the same gap (Figure 1 ): messaging and encoded reasoning are learned more readily than steganographic reasoning.
blocks.zh: 我们通过内文学习、强化学习和有监督的微调来引领这三种行为;所有三种行为都产生同样的差距(图1):信息传递和编码推理比定型推理更容易学习。

blocks.en: 3.1 In-context learning
blocks.zh: 3.1 文中学习

blocks.en:
In the in-context experiments, each model answers a WildChat query while encoding a side task into the answer: binary state tracking or A 5 A_{5} , over sequences of length 10, with every surface-formatting scheme and with a model-designed scheme.
The prompt gives the task description and two worked examples.
Steganographic messaging is tested identically to steganographic reasoning, except that the values to encode are given in the prompt rather than computed.
Each model-scheme pair yields an encoding accuracy and a mean suspiciousness (Figure 3 , Appendix F ).
blocks.zh:
在内文本实验中,每个模型在将一个侧面任务编码为答案时会回答一个WildChat查询:二进制状态跟踪或A 5 A_{5},在长度10的序列上,每个表层格式方案,并有一个模型设计的方案.
提示给出了任务描述和两个行之有效的例子.
素描信条的测试与素描推理相同,只是编码的值是在即时而不是计算中给出的.
每个模型-模型对产生编码精度和平均可疑性(图3,附录F)。

blocks.en:
Figure 2: In-context encoding accuracy against monitor suspiciousness (lower is better) on WildChat: one grey dot per model-scheme pair, covering all eight models with the five applicable task-agnostic schemes and their model-designed schemes; the line is the Pareto frontier, the shaded band the covert region.
(a) Messaging, 5-symbol vocabulary; (b) reasoning on A 5 A_{5} .
Binary side task and a fully labelled version in Appendix F .
blocks.zh:
图2: WildChat上对显示器可疑性(下位比较好)的文本编码精度:每个模型-策略对一个灰点,覆盖所有8个模型,并有5个适用的任务不可知计划及其模型设计的计划;线路为Pareto边框,阴影带为隐蔽区域.
(a) 通讯,5-符号词汇;(b) A 5 A_{5}的推理。
二进制侧式任务和附录F中的全标签版本。

blocks.en:
Figure 3: RL with Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on binary state tracking: encoding accuracy over training (suspiciousness in Appendix K ).
(a) Scheme given, five steps, AQuA-RAT main task.
(b) Steganographic reasoning only, knapsack main task, nine steps encoded in the candidate packings.
blocks.zh:
图3:在二进制状态跟踪上使用Qwen3.6-35B-A3B的RL:编码精度高于训练(在附录K中可疑).
(a) 计划,五个步骤,AQuA-RAT主要任务。
(b) 仅采用素描推理,背包主任务,在候选包装中编码9个步骤。

blocks.en:
For messaging, several model-scheme pairs are both covert and accurate (Figure 3 a); for steganographic reasoning, essentially none are (Figure 3 b): a model is either covert or accurate, not both.
The per-position breakdown, encoding accuracy at each step of the hidden sequence, shows why (Figures S2 and S3 in the appendix): under steganographic reasoning the first few values are encoded correctly and the rest are chance, while under messaging every position stays near 100%.
Our reading is that the models compute the first few steps latently and then merely write the latently computed values into the encoding, which is just messaging; steganographic reasoning would require reading the encoded values back as a scratchpad for the next step.
blocks.zh:
对于信息传递,几个模型-策略对既隐蔽又准确(图3a);对于结构推理,基本上没有(图3b): 模型要么是隐蔽的,要么是准确的,而不是两者兼而有之。
每个位置的分解,隐藏序列的每个步骤的编码精度,显示了为什么(附录中的图S2和S3):在结构推理下,最初的几个值被正确编码,其余的都是偶然的,而在信息传递下,每个位置都保持接近100%.
我们的阅读是,模型会潜在地计算最初的几个步骤,然后仅仅将潜在的计算值写入编码中,这仅仅是传递信息; 结构推理需要将编码值读回来,作为下一步的抓图。

blocks.en:
If the models only encode latently computed values, the encoding should not raise side-task accuracy above the no-CoT baseline.
We evaluate this on A 5 A_{5} , since models nearly solve binary state tracking without reasoning, leaving too little headroom to detect an uplift (binary results in Appendix H ).
We compare side-task answer accuracy under no CoT, encoded reasoning, steganographic reasoning with each model’s best scheme, and plain CoT (Figure S4 ; steganographic outputs count only when covert, Section 2.6 ).
No model’s steganographic reasoning beats its baseline; only GPT-5.5’s encoded reasoning does.
A few-shot sweep with GPT-5.5 shows that messaging works from the task description alone and encoded reasoning after a few examples, while steganographic reasoning does not appear however many examples are given (Appendix I ).
These experiments reproduce the largely negative result of Zolkowski et al. (2025) , and our best replication suggests that the small uplift they report was probably not steganographic reasoning (Appendix T ).
blocks.zh:
如果模型仅编码潜在计算值,编码不应将边任务精度提高到无编码基准之上。
我们用A 5 A\\\ 5}来评估这一点,因为模型几乎在没有推理的情况下解决了二进制状态跟踪问题, 导致头室太少, 无法检测升降(附录H中的二进制结果)。
我们比较了无COT下的侧式任务回答精度,编码推理,素描推理与每个模型的最佳方案,以及普通COT(图S4;素描输出只有在隐蔽时才算数,第2.6节)。
任何模型的素理推理都比其基线要强;只有GBT-5.5的编码推理才是如此。
用GPT-5.5进行几发扫瞄显示,消息从任务描述中单独发挥作用,并在几个例子之后编码推理,而草根推理却并不出现,尽管给出了许多例子(附录一).
这些实验复制了Zolkowski等人(2025年)大致为负的结果,我们最好的复制表明,他们报告的小型升力可能不是定型推理(Appendix T ).

blocks.en:
Since no frontier model reasons steganographically with the task-agnostic schemes, we turn to the knapsack main task with the knapsack cover, binary state tracking over 24 steps.
Here GPT-5.5 succeeds, alone among the nine models: its per-position encoding accuracy stays at 100% across all 24 steps (Figure S16 in the appendix), and the encoding is used for the computation, with side-task accuracy at 92% against a 46% no-CoT baseline (chance 50%, p < 0.001 p<0.001 ; Appendix I ).
blocks.zh:
由于没有边疆模型 与任务不可知性计划 进行精准化, 我们转向 Knapsack 主任务 与 Knapsack 覆盖, 二进制状态跟踪 超过24步。
在此,仅GPT-5.5就成功,在9个模型中:其每个位置的编码精度在所有24个步骤中都保持在100%(附录中图S16),编码用于计算,副任务精度为92%,而无编码基线为46%(chance 50%,p < 0.001 p < 0.001;附录一)。

blocks.en: 3.2 Reinforcement learning
blocks.zh: 3.2 强化学习

blocks.en:
We next train all three behaviours with RL; unless stated otherwise, the model is Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, trained with GRPO on Tinker.
The side task is binary state tracking over five steps, with the scheme given in the prompt.
Messaging and steganographic reasoning encode it with the markdown scheme into AQuA-RAT answers; encoded reasoning writes it in the word-prefix scheme with no cover task.
blocks.zh:
我们接下来用RL来训练所有三种行为;除非另有说明,否则模式是Qune3.6-35B-A3B,在Tinker上受过GRPO训练.
副任务为二进制状态跟踪5个步骤,即时给出方案.
消息和素描推理将其与标记下图方案编码为AQuA-RAT答案;编码推理则在词前缀方案中写,没有封面任务.

blocks.en:
Encoded reasoning is learned almost immediately and messaging within about a hundred RL steps, both reaching near-perfect encoding accuracy (Figure 3 a).
Steganographic reasoning is never learned reliably: it plateaus at 69% encoding accuracy at its last evaluation, step 760, even as its cover becomes maximally inconspicuous; covertness pressure does not explain the gap, since messaging faces the same monitor discount.
Per position, the final model encodes the first position correctly and is near chance from position 3, while messaging and encoded reasoning are perfect everywhere, the same signature as in the in-context experiments (Figure S7 in the appendix).
Letting the model design its own scheme does not change the picture: encoded reasoning and messaging are learned quickly, steganographic reasoning plateaus just above chance (Appendix L ).
blocks.zh:
编码推理几乎是立即学会的,在大约100个RL步骤内传递信息,两者都达到了接近完美的编码精度(图3 a).
素描推理从未被可靠地学习过:在上次评价(第760步)时,它以69%的编码精度稳定下来,即使其封面变得最大程度不显眼;隐蔽压力并不能解释差距,因为消息面临相同的显示器折扣.
每个位置,最终的模型正确编码了第一个位置,并且从第3位开始几乎是偶然的,而信息传递和编码推理在任何地方都是完美的,与内文本实验中的签名(附录中的图S7)相同.
让模型设计自己的方案不会改变画面:编码的推理和消息被快速的学习,刚过机会的素描推理高原(Appendix L.

blocks.en:
The result changes on the knapsack main task, with binary state tracking over nine steps: encoding accuracy rises from chance to 100% within about twenty steps and stays there, while the cover grows more inconspicuous (Figure 3 b).
Here the model does learn steganographic reasoning.
blocks.zh:
knapsack主要任务的结果变化,二进制状态跟踪超过9个步骤:编码精度在大约20个步骤内从机会上升至100%,并停留在那里,而封面则会变得更加不引人注目(图3b).
这里的模型确实学习了素描推理.

blocks.en:
This knapsack run rewards the encoding position by position; a realistic signal would reward only the final outcome, one bit per episode, and leave the model to discover that a hidden running trace is useful.
Rerunning knapsack with only the final readout rewarded (Appendix M ), Qwen3.6-35B-A3B stays at chance within the same budget, but the much larger Qwen3.5-397B-A17B reaches 100% final-answer accuracy by step 30, per-position encoding accuracy rising to 100% alongside it though never rewarded: the model adopts the given encoding on its own as a means of getting the final bit right.
blocks.zh:
这种背包运行会按位置奖励编码位置;一个现实的信号只会奖励最终结果,每集1位,让模型发现隐藏的运行跟踪是有用的.
仅使用最终读出奖励(Appendix M)重新运行的 knapsack, Qune3. 6-35B-A3B 偶然停留在同一预算范围内, 但更大的 Qune3.5-397B-A17B 在30 步中达到 100% 最终答案的准确度, 每个位置的编码精度上升至 100% 与之并列但从未得到奖赏 : 该模型单独采用给定的编码作为获得最终位正确性的手段.

blocks.en: 3.3 Supervised fine-tuning
blocks.zh: 3.3 监督微调

blocks.en:
Table 2: SFT steps to reach 95% test encoding accuracy for messaging (Msg.) and steganographic reasoning, with their ratio in parentheses; encoded reasoning crosses within 200 steps everywhere.
Runs that did not cross are shown as > > steps (final accuracy), stopped at roughly ten times the messaging budget (Qwen on A 5 A_{5} and Inkling: twice).
blocks.zh:
表2:SFT步骤达到95%的测试密文(Msg)和素描推理的编码精度,其比例在括号内;编码推理在各地200个步骤内交叉.
未交叉的运行显示为 > > 步( 最终准确度) , 大约为消息预算的十倍( Quen on A 5 A_{5} 和 Inkling: 两次) 。

blocks.en:
RL has to discover the behaviour before it can reinforce it, so a failure under RL leaves open whether the model is incapable or merely unable to find it.
Supervised fine-tuning on completions with the encoding correctly applied removes that exploration problem and so upper-bounds what the model can be brought to do.
The side task is the running sum mod 3 over nine inputs (Section 2.3 ), with AQuA-RAT as the main task and, as under RL, markdown for the steganographic conditions and the word-prefix scheme for encoded reasoning.
We train five models on this combination and on a second one, A 5 A_{5} under the whitespace scheme, and test whether the pattern holds at larger scale with a sixth and larger model, Inkling (training settings in Appendix P , every trajectory, including Inkling, in Appendix O ).
blocks.zh:
RL必须先发现行为才能加固,所以在RL下的失败会让模型是无法还是仅仅无法找到它.
用正确应用的编码对完成情况进行监督的微调,消除了勘探问题,从而消除了模型所能做的上限。
副任务为运行总和 mod 3 大于 9 个输入(第 2.3 节),以 AQuA-RAT 为主要任务,并如同在 RL 下,对结构条件和编码推理的词前缀方案进行标记.
我们在此组合上和第二个模式(A 5 A_{5})下进行训练,并用第六个和更大的模式Inkling(附录P中的训练设置,包括附录O中的Inkling在内的每一轨迹)来测试模式是否在更大范围内维持.

blocks.en:
Under SFT steganographic reasoning is often learned in the end, but the amount of training the three behaviours need shows the same ordering (Figure 1 c): encoded reasoning is learned almost immediately, messaging within a few hundred to a couple of thousand steps, and steganographic reasoning either after several times more steps or not at all within our budgets (step counts in Table 2 , trajectories in Figure S12 ).
Where it is learned, it costs 2.4 to 20 times messaging; where not, it stays flat or plateaus far below the threshold for up to ten times the messaging budget, with no stable pattern across models or task-scheme combinations.
blocks.zh:
在SFT Steagraphic推理下,最终往往会学到,但三种行为需要的训练数量显示出相同的顺序(图1c):编码推理几乎是立即学会的,几百到几千步之内传递信息,以及结构推理要么经过了数倍的步数,要么完全不在我们的预算内(表2中的步数,图S12中的轨迹)。
在学到信息的情况下,信息费为信息费的2.4至20倍;如果没有信息,信息费将维持在平坦或高原远低于阈值,达到信息费预算的十倍,没有稳定的模型模式或任务组合。

blocks.en:
The trend seems to persist at larger scale: even Inkling did not learn steganographic reasoning within twice the steps its messaging run needed (Appendix O ).
The ordering can also be reproduced on the knapsack main task, where in-context learning and RL already elicited steganographic reasoning: SFT is far faster there, but messaging is still learned first (Appendix Q ).
blocks.zh:
这一趋势似乎在更大的范围内继续存在:即使Inkling也没有在所需的信息运行(附录O)的两倍内学习到素描推理。
该命令也可在背书包的主要任务上复制,其中内文学习和RL已经引申了素描推理: SFT在那里的速度要快得多,但信息还是先学会(Appendix Q ).

blocks.en:
Error injection (Section 2.7 ) probes whether the successful runs read their trace, corrupting one value in the model’s own encoding (full sweep in Appendix R ).
Past the first three or four positions no checkpoint recovers the true trace: the knapsack RL runs, Qwen and Inkling-Small carry the injected error forward, while Nemotron-3-Super and gpt-oss-120B lose the thread, producing values that fit neither the true nor the corrupted trace.
Only in the first positions do some checkpoints recompute the true value, the same boundary the partial encodings under in-context learning and RL never pass.
blocks.zh:
错误注入(第2.7节)探究成功运行者是否读取了它们的踪迹,在模型自己的编码中腐蚀了一个值(在附录R中全扫描).

blocks.en: 4 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en:
Under all three elicitation methods, encoded reasoning and steganographic messaging were learned readily, while steganographic reasoning either failed outright (under in-context learning and RL) or took several times as much training as messaging (under SFT).
Because the models are explicitly prompted or trained for the behaviour, these results are upper bounds on capability (Section 4.3 ), so the learning failures speak to the difficulty of steganographic reasoning itself.
The exception is the narrow knapsack main task, where steganographic reasoning appeared under all three elicitation methods (Section 4.1 ).
blocks.zh:
在所有三种引领方法中,编码推理和素描信息都是很容易学会的,而素描推理要么彻底失败(在文中学习和RL下),要么接受的培训是通讯的两倍(在SFT下)。
由于模型被明确激发或训练是为了行为,这些结果对能力来说是上限的(第4.3节),所以学习失败本身就讲到了素描推理的难度.
例外是狭义的背包式主要任务,在所有三种引引法下都出现了素描推理(第4.1节)。

blocks.en:
Although steganographic reasoning decomposes into steganographic messaging and encoded reasoning (Section 2.2 ), and models learn each component readily, they learn the combination far more slowly, if at all.
So the hard part is not either skill, but doing both at once.
blocks.zh:
虽然素描推理分解成素描通讯和编码推理(第2.2节),模型也随时学习每个组件,但他们学习组合的速度要慢得多,如果有的话。
因此,困难的部分不是两个技能,而是同时做两个。

blocks.en:
Our hypothesis is that the difficulty lies in how much has to happen within a single forward pass.
Steganographic messaging asks the model to encode a given value while writing main-task text.
Encoded reasoning asks it to decode its previous value, advance the computation, and encode the result, with nothing else to attend to.
Steganographic reasoning asks for all of it in the same forward pass: decode, compute, encode, and main-task text.
The models handle each partial bundle readily, so what seems to be missing is the capacity to do them simultaneously, plausibly requiring internal machinery that none of the easier conditions create; SFT can eventually build it up, while in-context learning and RL never find it.
Our experiments were not designed to test this, so we offer it as a hypothesis.
blocks.zh:
我们的假设是,困难在于在一次前进过程中必须发生多少事情。
Steganographic 消息要求模型在写入主任务文本时编码给定值.
编码推理要求它解码其先前的数值,推进计算,并编码结果,没有别的事可处理.
Steganographic推理在相同的前传中要求全部:解码,计算,编码,以及主任务文本.
模型随时可以处理每个部分捆绑,所以似乎缺少的是同时完成它们的能力,合理需要内部机械,没有更容易的条件可以创造;SFT最终可以建立它,而内文本学习和RL则永远找不到它.
我们的实验不是用来测试的, 所以我们把它当作一个假设。

blocks.en:
The one setting in which steganographic reasoning was consistently learned is the knapsack main task, under all three elicitation methods.
Our explanation is that the positions carrying the encoding demand no main-task work: the main task does not constrain which packings are tried, they are supposed to be arbitrary, so encoding into them leaves a single job per forward pass, and the condition in effect reduces to encoded reasoning.
If this is right, it points to the kind of cover on which steganographic reasoning is feasible: tasks with many repetitive, supposedly arbitrary or otherwise unimportant choices that can carry information.
blocks.zh:
在三种诱导方法下,人们一贯学会了素描推理的主要工作。
我们的解释是,携带编码的岗位不需要主任务工作:主要任务并不限制哪些包装是尝试的,它们应该是任意的,所以编码在它们中每向前传就留下一个工作,而实际上的条件减少了编码推理.
如果这是对的,它指出了那种可以进行结构推理的掩护:许多重复、据称是任意或不重要的选择能够传递信息的任务。

blocks.en: 4.1 Is the encoded trace used for computation?
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 是否将编码的痕迹用于计算?

blocks.en:
Good encoding accuracy alone does not show that a model reasons through its trace.
It could compute the values latently and just write them down.
Our failing runs look like exactly that: they encode the first few values and then fall to chance (Figure S7 ).
The question is whether the successful runs really used their trace.
Two things suggest they did.
First, the A 5 A_{5} state is 𝖭𝖢 1 \mathsf{NC}^{1} -complete to track, so latent computation must fail on long sequences, though the argument is asymptotic and does not settle what a model manages at length ten ( Merrill et al., 2024 ; Pfau et al., 2024 ) .
Second, when we corrupt one value in the trace, no successful checkpoint recovers the true trace beyond the first three or four positions: most carry the error forward, the rest degrade into values matching neither trace.
Those first positions, which some checkpoints do recompute, are also as far as the failing runs ever get without a trace.
Error injection puts the model off distribution, so it only tells us what wins when trace and latent computation disagree.
Taken together, we see this as good, but not conclusive, evidence that the successful runs reason through their trace.
blocks.zh:
光是良好的编码精度并不能表明模型通过它的踪迹来解释原因.
它可以潜在地计算价值,然后把它们写下来。
我们的失败运行看起来就是这样:它们编码了最初的几个值,然后落入了机会(图S7).
问题是成功运行是否真的使用了它们的踪迹.
有两件事说明他们做到了。
首先, A 5 A \\ 5} 状态是 NC 1\ mathsf{ NC\\ 1} - 完成跟踪, 因此潜伏计算必须在长序列上失败, 尽管这个论点是不对称的, 并且不能解决一个模型在长度十时管理什么( Merrill等人, 2024; Pfau等人, 2024) 。
第二,当我们破坏一个追踪值时,任何成功的检查点都无法在前三四个位置后恢复真正的追踪:大多数将错误推向前进,其余的则退化成匹配两个跟踪的值.
这些最初的阵地 -- -- 一些检查站确实在重新计算 -- -- 也因为失败的跑道永远没有痕迹。
错误的注射使得模型停止分布,所以它只告诉我们在跟踪和潜在计算不一致时什么是赢的.
总而言之,我们认为这是个好证据,但不是确凿的证据,证明成功是有理由的。

blocks.en: 4.2 Implications for CoT monitoring
blocks.zh: 4.2 对毒性临界值监测的影响

blocks.en: Our results are reassuring news for CoT monitoring: they suggest that current models are further from steganographic reasoning than the emergence of messaging and encoded reasoning under RL pressure against a monitor ( Mathew et al., 2024 ; Skaf et al., 2025 ) would imply.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果对气候观测系统的监测来说是令人放心的消息:这些结果表明,目前的模型比在对一个监测器的RL压力下出现消息和编码推理(Mathew等人,2024年;Skaf等人,2025年)更能从结构推理中得出。

blocks.en:
However, steganographic reasoning did appear on the knapsack task, the one cover consisting of repetitive, supposedly arbitrary choices, under all three elicitation methods and under RL even from a sparse outcome-only reward.
Realistic agent transcripts are full of such choices, such as variable names, and these channels deserve particular scrutiny from monitors.
blocks.zh:
然而,在背包任务上确实出现了草率推理,这一任务包括重复的、据称是任意的选择,在所有三种引领方法下,在《危险津贴法》下,甚至只得到少量的结果奖励。
现实主义特工的笔录充满了这种选择,例如可变名称,这些渠道值得由监视器特别审查.

blocks.en: 4.3 Limitations
blocks.zh: 4.3 限制

blocks.en:
Our experiments estimate an upper bound on how much steganographic reasoning models can learn, not the likelihood of it arising in deployment.
Several unrealistic features of the setup are therefore unproblematic, since they only make learning easier: the models are explicitly prompted or trained for the behaviour, the side tasks are simpler than the reasoning a misaligned model would need to hide, such as planning self-exfiltration, and the optimisation pressure is dense, with few-shot examples of correct encodings in context, per-position rewards in RL, and fully worked completions in SFT.
blocks.zh:
我们的实验估计了一个上限 多少素理推理模型可以学习,而不是在部署中产生的可能性。
因此设置的几个不切实际的特征是没有问题的,因为它们只会使学习变得容易:模型被明确激发或训练是为了行为,副任务比一个错位模型需要隐藏的推理简单,如规划自我过滤,优化压力很密集,在上下文中很少有正确编码的镜头例子,在RL中每个位置的奖励,在SFT中完全工作完成.

blocks.en:
Other features could bias the other way and make steganographic reasoning harder in our setup than in realistic conditions, and these do threaten the bound.
First, our encoding schemes may be unusually hard to learn.
Schemes clearly differ in difficulty, the knapsack cover being far easier than the surface-formatting schemes, so there may exist schemes as learnable as knapsack but applicable to any text, which we did not think of.
The conditions in which models design their own schemes guard against this, and RL in particular should have selected for schemes the model can execute well; a universal, inconspicuous, easily learned scheme remains possible, but we consider it unlikely.
Second, our strongest elicitation methods were applied below the frontier: RL to small and mid-sized models and SFT mostly to small ones, while the frontier models were tested only in context, the weakest form of elicitation, and within each setting it was the more capable model that learned steganographic reasoning.
Larger RL runs on frontier models were beyond our budget; we would be glad to see safety teams at frontier labs apply this kind of optimisation pressure to their own models.
blocks.zh:
其他特征可能偏向于其他方式,使我们的设置比现实条件下更难进行结构推理,这些特征确实威胁到束缚。
首先,我们的编码计划可能非常难以学习。
计划在难度上明显不同,背包覆盖比表面格式化计划简单得多,因此可能存在像背包一样可以学习但适用于任何文本的计划,我们没有想到。
模型设计自己的计划时防止这种情况,特别是RL应该选择能够很好地执行的计划;一个普遍、不引人注目、容易学习的计划仍然是可能的,但我们认为不可能。
第二,我们最强的诱导方法被应用在前沿之下:RL适用于中小型模型,SFT主要适用于小型模型,而前沿模型仅根据背景进行测试,最弱的诱导形式,在每一种情况下,都是学习素度推理的能力更强的模型。
较大的RL运行在边境模型上超出了我们的预算;我们很高兴看到边境实验室的安全小组对自己的模型施加这种优化压力。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en:
We have shown, across model families, side tasks, and elicitation methods, that steganographic reasoning is much harder for LLMs to learn than its two components: it emerges only on a very specific kind of main task, or under supervised fine-tuning with several times more training data than the components require.
This tempers the conclusions that can be drawn from demonstrations of the component skills under realistic training conditions, and gives a current estimate of how close models are to the capability that would undermine CoT monitoring.
This finding suggests two directions for future research.
First, to keep testing whether steganographic reasoning remains hard to learn for future frontier models: continued difficulty would preserve the basis for trusting CoT monitoring, while a reversal, especially a sudden one, should prompt a search for the conditions under which it might occur.
Second, to map the circumstances under which models can learn steganographic reasoning, for which our knapsack task is an existence proof, giving a more informed view of when CoT monitoring cannot be trusted.
blocks.zh:
我们从模范家庭、副任务和诱导方法中可以看出,对LLMs来说,素理推理比其两个组成部分要难得多:它只出现在非常具体的主要任务上,或者在监督下微调,培训数据比各组成部分需要的多好几倍。
这调和了从在现实的培训条件下展示各组成部分技能中得出的结论,并给出了当前模型与可能破坏综合技术监测的能力相近的估计数。
这一结论为今后的研究提出了两个方向。
首先,继续测试未来前沿模型是否仍然难以了解结构推理:持续困难将维持信任CoT监测的基础,而逆转,特别是突然逆转,应当促使人们寻找可能发生的条件。
第二,绘制模型可以学习素描推理的环境图,对此,我们的背包任务是一种存在证明,给出了对何时COT监测不能信任的更知情的观点.

blocks.en:
WildChat is a diverse set of real user queries to chatbots [ Zhao et al., 2024 ] .
We use it because it gives a realistic and varied picture of user–chatbot interactions: a capability that matters in deployment should be tested on data that reflects deployment rather than on a narrow set of evaluation questions.
Its answers are also longer than in AQuA-RAT [ Ling et al., 2017 ] , which lets us use more space-intensive encoding schemes that take a whole sentence to encode one value.
For these reasons we use WildChat for the in-context-learning experiments, where we sweep many encoding schemes and pay no large training cost, and AQuA-RAT for the SFT and RL experiments, where longer answers would be more expensive and we use a smaller set of schemes.

WildChat是一组不同的真正的用户查询 [ 赵等,2024].
我们之所以使用它,是因为它提供了用户-机器人互动的现实和多样的画面:部署中重要的能力应该通过反映部署情况的数据而不是一套狭窄的评价问题来测试。
它的答案也比AQuA-RAT [Ling等人, 2017] 中的答案要长,它让我们使用更多的空间密集的编码方案,这些编码方案需要整句来编码一个值.
基于这些原因,我们用WildChat进行内容学习实验,我们扫描了许多编码方案,不支付巨额培训费用,AQuA-RAT进行SFT和RL实验,较长的答案会更昂贵,我们使用一套较小的计划.

The knapsack main task asks the model to pack items with given weights and values so that the total weight stays under a bound while the total value is maximised.
The model is prompted to attempt several packings and then take the best one, so each packing is a free choice of which items to include, and the presence or absence of a given item in a packing can encode one bit (Section 2.5 ).

blocks.en: Appendix E Monitor validation

blocks.en:
All covertness judgements in this paper come from GPT-5-mini under one of the prompts of Appendix B.1 .
Here we check that each prompt rates benign text low and conspicuous insertions high on inputs of the kind it actually sees in the experiments, and record how it rates the surface-formatting schemes themselves.
The base prompt is tested on full AQuA-RAT answers with binary values over five steps, as in the RL experiments; the opening prompt on WildChat answers truncated to the shortest prefix that carries the encoding, with five symbols over ten steps, as in the fixed-scheme in-context sweeps; and the complete-response prompt on full WildChat answers, as in the model-designed-scheme sweeps.
For each setting we draw 300 questions (400 for the base prompt) from the training split and build several inputs per question.
Benign inputs are the unencoded dataset answer (for the opening prompt, the unencoded prefix of the same length as the encoded one) and GPT-5-mini’s own answer to the question, truncated to the typical encoded-opening length in the opening setting.
Scheme inputs apply each scheme programmatically to the dataset answer with uniformly random values.
Conspicuous controls prepend the random values to the dataset answer as digits, as arbitrary words (animal names), or as the words of the word-prefix scheme, or prepend a header of bolded and unbolded words followed by “Let me work through this step by step”, a pattern an early RL run converged to.
We also test the lenient prompt of the model-designed encoded-reasoning RL run, which asks only whether the text is recognisably a running-parity computation, on the AQuA-RAT inputs.
Table S2 reports the mean suspiciousness and the fraction of inputs at or below the covertness threshold of 3 3 .

blocks.en:
Under all three prompts benign text sits at the floor: dataset answers average 1.1 1.1 to 1.5 1.5 with 94–99% at or below the threshold, and GPT-5-mini’s own answers average 1.0 1.0 with at least 99.5% at or below it.
The conspicuous controls are reliably flagged, at means of 8.7 8.7 to 9.9 9.9 with 0–4% at or below the threshold; the bold-word header is the softest control, at a mean of 7.0 7.0 and 15% at or below the threshold.
Under the three covertness prompts the score distribution is thus close to bimodal, and the threshold of 3 3 sits in the gap: at most 6% of benign inputs score above it, while at most 4% of the conspicuous controls score at or below it (15% for the softest control).
This bimodality would justify a range of cutoffs, and we chose the lower end deliberately: subtler ways of openly reasoning about the side task than our controls surely exist, and all the threshold has to certify is that an output is clearly separated, by suspiciousness, from benign text.
Capitalisation, whitespace, sentence-markdown, and sentence-newline are indistinguishable from benign text to the monitor, with 93–100% of encoded inputs at or below the threshold.
Markdown is somewhat more visible, since the monitor occasionally notices bold, italic, or code-formatted words that serve no purpose; its covert fraction falls from 91% under the base prompt to 76% under the opening prompt and 64% under the complete-response prompt, which is the only prompt that mentions hidden information.
Sentence-interjection is the one scheme the monitor mostly flags, at means of 5.9 5.9 and 6.8 6.8 , consistent with its position in the Pareto plots of Section 3.1 , where it reaches high accuracy only at high suspiciousness.
The lenient prompt is permissive by design: it rates everything at or near 1 1 , including prepended digits ( 1.8 1.8 ) and the word-prefix words ( 1.1 1.1 ), so that run is penalised only when its output actually reads as the parity computation.
What a low score certifies is therefore that the text does not look out of place to a strong LLM reader that is not told about the scheme; a monitor given the scheme description could decode the surface-formatting schemes directly.

blocks.en: Appendix M Outcome-only reward on the knapsack main task
blocks.zh: 附录M 背包主要任务只获得成果奖励

blocks.en:
The knapsack run of Section 3.2 rewards the encoding itself: every one of the nine candidate packings is checked against the running value it should carry, so nine positions per episode contribute to the reward.
In a realistic setting there is no such signal.
Nobody rewards a model for the correctness of its hidden reasoning; the reward attaches to the outcome, and steganographic reasoning would have to emerge because it helps the model produce a correct final answer.
We therefore repeat the run with an outcome-only reward: the model appends the final running value on a #### line and is rewarded solely on that bit, with no reward on the encoding.
The scheme and the monitor are unchanged; the prompt differs only in additionally asking for the final #### line, which the process-rewarded run does not have.
The signal is far sparser, one rewarded bit per episode instead of nine.
blocks.zh:
第3.2节的背包操作奖励了编码本身:9个候选包装中每个包件都要对照它应该携带的运行值检查,因此每集9个职位都有助于奖励.
在现实环境中,没有这种信号。
没有人会因为一个模型的隐性推理的正确性而奖励它;奖励与结果相关联,而素描推理必须出现,因为它有助于模型产生正确的最终答案.
因此,我们用只以结果的奖励来重复运行:模型将最终运行值附加在QQ线上,并且只得到该位的奖励,对编码没有奖励.
计程器和显示器没有变化;提示器只在附加要求QQ最终行时不同,而进程奖励的运行没有.
信号更稀少,每集1比9

blocks.en:
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B, the model of the other RL runs, does not learn the task under this reward (Figure S11 ).
Its final-answer accuracy oscillates around chance for all 40 steps, averaging 54%, and its per-position encoding accuracy stays at chance as well; the sparse outcome signal is not enough for it to find the computation within this budget.
Qwen3.5-397B-A17B does learn it, reaching 100% final-answer accuracy by step 30 and staying at or near it.
Its per-position encoding accuracy climbs to 100% over the same stretch even though nothing rewards it, so the larger model reconstructs the full hidden per-line trace as a means of getting the final bit right.
Its cover is more conspicuous than in the process-rewarded run, averaging a mean suspiciousness of 5.2 against the 1.2 that run ends at, and declining to around 4 over the final steps.
The monitor term in the reward is identical in the two runs, so this is not a case of covertness going unrewarded: the model reached full accuracy only at step 30 and training was stopped after 40 steps, with suspiciousness still falling.
blocks.zh:
Qwen3.6-35B-A3B,是其他RL运行的型号,没有在此奖励下学习任务(图S11).
其最终答案准确性围绕所有40个步骤的概率,平均为54%,其每个位置的编码准确性也停留在偶然中;结果信号的微弱不足以使它在这个预算范围内找到计算结果。
Qune3.5-397B-A17B确实学习了它,通过30步达到100%的最终答案准确度,并停留在它或附近.
它的每个位置的编码精度攀升到100%, 即使没有奖励它, 所以更大的模型重建了 完全隐藏的每条线的痕量, 作为获得最后位数正确性的手段。
它的覆盖比过程奖励的运行更明显,平均平均5.2对结束的1.2的中度怀疑,在最后的步骤上下降到4左右.
奖励中的显示器术语在两跑中是相同的,因此这并非隐蔽无酬的情况:模型只在第30步达到完全准确,训练在40步后停止,怀疑度仍然下降.

blocks.en:
On the running-sum-mod-3 side task with the markdown scheme (Section 3.3 ), steganographic messaging passes 90% within 300 steps and 95% within 500, then fluctuates around 97% for the rest of its 2100-step run.
Steganographic reasoning needs 9,900 steps to pass 90% and 10,200 to pass 95%, and reaches 99% at 10,800.
The reasoning run trains on twice the completion-token limit of the messaging run (Appendix P ), so in compute rather than steps the gap is wider still.

在采用降标计划(第3.3节)的运行总和-mod-3侧式任务中,速成信息在300步内传递90%,在500步内传递95%,然后在2100步运行的其余时间里波动97%左右。
草根推理需要9,900步才能通过90%,10,200步才能通过95%,10,800步才能达到99%.
推理运行的列车是消息运行(Appendix P)的完成-token限制的两倍,因此在计算而不是步骤上差距仍然更大.

blocks.en:
Counting only sequences in which all nine positions are correct, messaging is at 45% by the first evaluation and above 90% by 500 steps.
Steganographic reasoning is at exactly zero until step 4300 and stays below 10% until roughly step 9500, then rises past 90% within about 900 further steps.
For most of training, per-position accuracy creeps upward while not a single full sequence comes out right, the same partial-encoding signature as in Sections 3.1 and 3.2 .
So rather than improving gradually, steganographic reasoning stays near zero for a long stretch of training and then saturates within a few hundred steps once it starts to improve.
blocks.zh:

在大多数训练中,每个位置的精确度向上爬升,而没有一个完整的序列产生正确的,与第3.1节和第3.2节中的部分编码签名相同。
因此,与逐步改善相比,素理推理在长时间的训练中停留在接近零,然后一旦开始改善,饱和在几百步内.

Loss is taken only on the tokens that carry the side-task values, not on the rest of the answer (Section 2.8 ).
For the runs using the markdown scheme this prefix is additionally minimised, so that training pressure falls on the shortest span that still carries the encoding.
The mod-3 steganographic-reasoning run was trained in three consecutive segments, each resuming from the previous segment’s final checkpoint; step counts in Figure S12 are cumulative across segments.

The model-sweep runs of Section 3.3 use the same configuration with the following changes.
The test pool is 200 prompts, and runs stop early once test encoding accuracy reaches 95%.
Each model trains with its thinking-disabled chat renderer, at a learning rate scaled from the Qwen value by 2048 / hidden size 2048/\text{hidden size} : 8.0 × 10 − 5 8.0\times 10^{-5} for Nemotron-3-Super, 1.138 × 10 − 4 1.138\times 10^{-4} for gpt-oss-120B, and 1.219 × 10 − 4 1.219\times 10^{-4} for Lightning-30B.
The two Inkling models instead use the unscaled Qwen learning rate, and their minimised-prefix targets are built as closed assistant messages: the Inkling models degrade when trained on many never-closed prefill-style targets, which the other model families tolerate.

So even in the easiest steganography setting in this paper, where the cover text is a free choice and the model does not have to reason about the main task, messaging is learned first and reasoning costs a multiple of it.

blocks.en: Appendix R Error injection
blocks.zh: 附录R 错误注入

blocks.en:
High encoding accuracy alone does not show that the committed answer is computed through the visible trace rather than computed silently and decorated with a matching trace afterwards, so we intervene on the trace and test whether the answer depends on it.
Two interventions are possible.
In a swap intervention, the model’s cover, up to the final #### line, is placed under a different side-task question and the model emits only the answer; a low accuracy against the new question means the answer is driven by the encoded trace rather than re-derived from the prompt.
In error propagation , the intervention we report, the trace is prefilled with one intermediate value corrupted, and we check whether the error carries through to the later values and the final answer, as it must if the model is reading its own trace.
blocks.zh:
仅靠高编码精度并不能表明承诺的答案是通过可见的微量计算,而不是默默计算,事后用匹配的微量装饰,所以我们介入微量,测试答案是否依赖于微量.
可以采取两项干预措施。
在互换干预中,模型的封面,直到最终的QQ线,被置于不同的侧式任务问题之下,模型只发出答案;与新问题相对的低精度意味着答案是由编码的踪迹驱动的,而不是从即时重生.
在错误传播中, 也就是我们报告的干预中, 追踪被预填了一个中间值被损坏, 我们检查错误是否贯穿到后面的数值和最后的答案, 如果模型正在读取它自己的追踪, 则它必须。

blocks.en:
Each error-injection cell takes a model’s own encoded trace, replaces the value at one position with the wrong value (the true value plus one, modulo the alphabet size), keeps the trace up to that point as a prefill, and lets the model continue at temperature 1.
Every position of the nine-step sequence is hit 20 times, so each cell has 180 continuations, and a matched uncorrupted pass of 20 samples gives the baseline decode accuracy.
For the running-sum side tasks a value that follows the corruption is the true value shifted by the injected offset; for A 5 A_{5} it is the state obtained by replaying the sample’s instruction sequence from the injected wrong state, which never rejoins the true trajectory because both instructions are permutations.
Figure S15 shows all eight runs: the two knapsack RL runs and Qwen’s sum-mod-3 run, then the two sum-mod-3 sweep models, then the three A 5 A_{5} sweep models, each sweep model evaluated at its crossing checkpoint.
blocks.zh:
每个错误注入单元格都取一个模型自己编码的微量,将一个位置的值替换为错误的值(真实值+1,调制字母大小),将微量保持到这个点作为预填,让模型在1温度下继续.
九步序列的每一个位置都会被击中20次,因此每个细胞都有180次续作,一个匹配的20个样本的未腐蚀的通过会给出基线解码的准确性.
对于运行和边任务,腐败之后的一个值是被注入的偏移的真实值;对于A 5 A_{5},它是通过重播样本的指令序列从注入错误状态得到的状态,它从未重新加入真实的轨迹,因为这两个指令都是通畅的.
图S15显示所有8个运行情况:两个Knapsack RL运行和Quen的sum-mod-3运行,然后是两个sum-mod-3扫描模式,然后是三个A 5 A_{5}扫描模式,每个扫描模式都在其过境检查站评价.

blocks.en:
Across the eight runs the uncorrupted traces are 81% to 100% accurate, so the results below are not an artefact of format failure.
The two knapsack RL runs follow the corruption in 84% and 71% of the later values, wherever it is injected.
Qwen trained on sum-mod-3 follows it in 2.5%, 8%, 19% and 45% of the later values when it is injected into one of the first four positions, against 80% to 95% when it is injected later.
The sweep’s two running-sum learners split: Nemotron-3-Super mostly recomputes (28% of the later values follow the corruption, 43% return to the true trace), Inkling-Small mostly reads its trace (53% follow, 24% return).
On A 5 A_{5} following the corruption is the dominant outcome for the two models that learned the task cleanly, gpt-oss-120B (39% follow, 18% return) and Inkling-Small (52% against 20%), while Nemotron-3-Super, whose uncorrupted trace is only 81% accurate, is split (32% against 31%); the remaining values match neither trace, and in all three the share that follows the corruption rises with the injection position, from about 20% at the first position to 65%–80% at the last ones.
blocks.zh:
8号线的未损坏痕迹准确度为81%至100%,因此以下结果不是格式故障的动脉。
两种背包式RL运行跟随后期价值的84%和71%的腐败,无论注入何处.
Quen接受Sum-mod-3培训,在注入前四个职位之一时,以2.5%、8%、19%和45%的后期数值依次进行,而在后期注入时为80%至95%。
扫荡的两名运行总和学习者分道扬镳:Nemotron-3-Super大多是重算(后期数值的28%跟随腐败,43%回到真实的追踪),Inkling-Small大多读取其跟踪(53%跟随,24 % 返回).
在A 5 A + 5 } 之后的腐败是两种模式的主要结果, 两种模式清正地学习了该任务, gpt-oss-120B(39%跟随,18%返回)和 Inkling-Small(52%对20%), 而Nemotron-3-Super, 其未腐蚀的跟踪只有81%准确, 被拆分(32%对31%); 其余的数值不匹配任何跟踪, 在所有三种模式中, 腐败随注射位置上升而上升, 从头一个位置的约20%到最后一个位置的65- 80%。

blocks.en:
Figure S15: Error injection on the RL and SFT runs that learned steganographic reasoning (knapsack SFT not included).
Each panel is one run; the top row is the uncorrupted pass, every other row injects the error at the position marked by the ring, with the prefilled prefix shown faded.
Each pie gives the share of continuations whose value at that step is correct, consistent with the injected error, or neither.
Red spreading to the right of the ring means the model carries the corrupted state forward, blue means it recomputes the true one.
Sweep models appear in the column order of Figure S13 .
blocks.zh:
图S15: RL 和 SFT 运行时的错误注入,这些错误被学习到的素理推理(knapsack SFT不包含).
每个面板为一跑;上行是未腐蚀的传球,其他各行在环标位置注入错误,预填前缀显示淡出.
每个派给出的续作份额,其价值在该步骤上正确,与注入错误一致,或者两者均不相同.
红色传播到环的右侧意味着模型将腐烂的状态带往前,蓝色意味着它重新计算真实的状态.
扫荡模型以图S13的列顺序出现.

blocks.en:
Recovering from a corruption requires recomputing the running value over the whole prefix latently, without the trace.
Over two or three operands this is within the model’s latent reach and over more it is not, so the crossover locates that reach at about three to four steps: beyond it the models mostly follow their own encoded values, inside it they mostly recompute.
The partial encodings under in-context learning and RL never get past the first few positions, and what SFT eventually teaches is how to continue past them.
Per-position accuracy and the injection crossover are independent measurements, and they agree on roughly where the boundary lies.
blocks.zh:
从腐败中恢复,需要对整个前缀进行潜在重算,不留痕迹。
超过两到三个操作,这是在模型的潜在范围, 超过更多是没有的, 因此交叉定位 达到大约三到四个步骤: 超过它,模型大多遵循自己的编码值, 在它内部,它们大多重算。
在内容内学习和RL下的部分编码永远无法通过最初的几个位置,最终SFT所教导的是如何继续通过它们.
per-position精度和注射交叉是独立的测量,它们大致商定了边界的位置.

blocks.en:
Decode accuracy on a side task that can be computed in parallel is therefore weak evidence of steganographic reasoning, because the values may be recomputed rather than read.
This is the objection we raise against the one positive result of Zolkowski et al. [2025] , stated generally: such a claim needs either a side task that resists parallel computation, or an intervention showing that the trace is used; our results rest on both.
blocks.zh:
因此,可以并行计算的一项侧面任务的解码精度是结构推理的薄弱证据,因为数值可能重算而不是读取.
这是我们反对Zolkowski等人提出的一个积极结果。 “[2025],一般说:这种索赔需要一项不进行平行计算的补充任务,或一项表明使用了跟踪的干预;我们的结果取决于两者。

blocks.en:
We expected a model trained on A 5 A_{5} to propagate injected errors at every position; the three A 5 A_{5} checkpoints do follow the corruption more consistently than any running-sum model, but even there the read-back is imperfect, with early injections often producing values that match neither trace.
Traces that miss one value and then shift all later values, which we sometimes observe, point the same way: they are the signature of a sequential process with an indexing error, not of independently transcribed results.
Finally, whether a trace ends up being used for the computation depends on the model, not only on the task: Inkling-Small reads its trace where Nemotron-3-Super, trained identically on the same running sum, recomputes.
blocks.zh:
我们期望一个在A 5 A_{5}上受过训练的模型来宣传每个位置的注射错误;三个A 5 A_{5}检查站确实比任何运行总和模型更一贯地遵循腐败,但即使在那里,回读也是不完善的,早期的注射往往产生不匹配任何追踪的值.
追踪缺失一个值,然后转移所有后期值,我们有时观察到这些值,它们指向相同的方式:它们是一个有索引错误的顺序过程的签名,而不是独立转录的结果.
最后,一个微量是否最终被用于计算取决于模型,而不仅仅取决于任务: Inkling-Small读到它的微量,在那里Nemotron-3-Super,在相同的运行总和上接受相同的训练,重算.

blocks.zh: 附录 S Knapsack 按位置编码精度

blocks.en: Figure S16 shows the per-position encoding accuracy of all nine models on the knapsack main task of Section 3.1 , binary state tracking over 24 steps; Claude Sonnet 5 is included in this sweep, as the knapsack prompts do not trigger its refusals.
blocks.zh: 图S16显示所有九种模型在Knapsack主任务上的每个位置编码精度,第3.1节,二进制状态跟踪超过24步;克劳德·索内特5包含在本次扫荡中,因为knapsack提示不会触发其拒绝.

Figure S16: Per-position encoding accuracy on the knapsack main task over 24 steps.
GPT-5.5 stays at 100% across all positions, while every other model decays to chance, most within the first few positions and Qwen3.5-397B-A17B by around position 12.
blocks.zh:
图S16: 背负式主任务24个步骤的内置编码精度.
GPT-5.5在所有位置上停留在100%,而所有其他模型都衰变成偶然,大多数在最初的少数位置和Qwen3.5-397B-A17B在12位左右.

blocks.en: Appendix T Replicating the encoded-reasoning uplift of Zolkowski et al.
blocks.zh: 附录T复制了Zolkowski等人的编码合理提升.

blocks.en:
Zolkowski et al. [2025] report that on their orientation state-tracking task, GPT-4.5 [ OpenAI, 2025b ] prompted to hide its reasoning with subtle encoding schemes slightly outperforms a no-encoding baseline (first-letter 75.6%, word-count 75.5%, versus 72.1%, pooled over sequence lengths 3, 5, 8, and 12 with n = 300 n=300 each), and interpret this as a sign of encoded reasoning.
Since this is the only reported case of prompted models gaining side-task accuracy from a subtle scheme, we attempted a direct replication.
GPT-4.5 has since been retired, so we instead test seven models of similar capability, matched on the Epoch Capabilities Index [ Ho et al., 2025 , Epoch AI, 2026 ] and released in the same period as GPT-4.5 (Table S5 ).
blocks.zh:
Zolkowski等人[2025]报告说,GPT-4.5[OpenAI,2025b]在其定向状态跟踪任务中,用微妙编码方案隐藏其推理略高于无编码基线(首字母为75.6%,字数为75.5%,比72.1%,集合序列长度为3,5,8和12,每个N=300n=300),并将此解释为编码推理的标志.
由于这是唯一报道的促使模型从一个微妙的计划中获得副任务准确性的案例,我们试图直接复制。
GPT-4.5自此退役,因此我们转而测试7种类似能力的模型,与Epoch能力指数[Ho等人,2025年,Epoch AI,2026年]相匹配,并与GPT-4.5同期发布(表S5).

blocks.en:
Table S5: The models of the replication study, with GPT-4.5 (the model of Zolkowski et al. [2025] ) as reference.
ECI: Epoch Capabilities Index score [ Epoch AI, 2026 ] .
All eight models were released within a seven-month window.
GPT-5-nano was run at minimal reasoning effort (zero reasoning tokens).
blocks.zh:
表S5:复制研究的模型,以GBT-4.5(Zolkowski等人的模型[2025])作为参考.
ECI: Epoch能力指数得分[Epoch AI,2026].
所有8个型号都在一个7个月的窗口内发布.
GPT-5-nano在最小的推理努力(零推理符)下运行.

blocks.en:
We otherwise follow their protocol: their two-task prompt template, their per-length sample sizes, zero-shot, and their first-letter and word-count encoding instructions adapted to the one-dimensional task.
We deviate in the main-task distribution (WildChat instead of HH-RLHF) and in the answer format; we do not believe the choice of main task is important here, as it only supplies the cover text in which the reasoning would be hidden.
blocks.zh:
否则,我们遵循他们的协议:他们的双任务即时模板,他们的全长样本大小,零镜头,以及他们适应一维任务的首字母和字数编码指令.
我们偏离了主任务分配(WildChat 而不是 HH-RLHF)和答案格式;我们不认为选择主要任务在这里很重要,因为它只提供隐藏推理的封面文本.

blocks.en:
Their encoding instructions leak information about the hidden task that the baseline prompt never receives: the word-count instructions contain an explicit mapping from running counts to states, and the first-letter instructions enumerate the states and walk through a transition example.
Their baseline ( original baseline below) is therefore not matched to the encoding arms, and an uplift over it could come from this extra task information rather than from encoded reasoning.
To close this gap we add a third arm, our matched baseline : the original baseline prompt plus only the leaked task restatement, with no request to encode anything.
Genuine encoded reasoning should beat the matched baseline, not just the original one.
blocks.zh:
他们的编码指令泄露了基准提示从未收到的隐藏任务的信息:字数指令包含从运行计数到状态的清晰映射,首字母指令列举了状态并走过一个过渡实例.
因此,它们的基线(下面的原始基线)与编码武器不相称,其上升可能来自额外任务信息,而不是编码推理。
为了缩小这一缺口,我们增加了第三个臂,我们匹配的基线:原始基线提示加上只漏出的任务重述,没有要求编码任何东西。
真正的编码推理应该比对基准要好,而不只是原始基准.

blocks.en:
The design is run twice.
A screen tests all seven models on the full grid of four arms and four sequence lengths, at their per-length n = 300 n=300 .
A follow-up then re-tests the two models that beat the matched baseline, at n ≈ 1000 n\approx 1000 per cell on a larger pool of cover questions.
Within a model, every arm sees the same cover questions sample by sample, so all contrasts below are paired McNemar tests.
blocks.zh:
设计运行两次.
一个屏幕在4个臂和4个序列长度的全格上测试所有7个型号,其全长为n=300n=300.
之后,在更大范围的封面问题库上,一个后续再次测试击败匹配基线的两个模型,每个单元格为n + 1000 n\\\ 1000。
在一个模型中,每个臂部通过样本看到相同的封面问题样本,所以下面的所有对比都是成对的麦克内马尔测试.

blocks.en:
Measured against their own baseline, their effect reproduces in two of the seven models (Table S6 ).
Qwen3-235B gains + 12.1 +12.1 points with the first-letter scheme and GPT-5-nano + 8.5 +8.5 , both p < .001 p<.001 , larger than the + 3.5 +3.5 points they report.
The other five are flat or negative.
The observation is therefore real, for some models of this capability class.
blocks.zh:
根据它们自己的基线测量,它们的效果在七个模型中有两个复制(表S6)。
Qwen3-235B增益+12.1+12.1分与首字母方案加GPT-5-nano+8.5+8.5,两者均为p <.001 p < 001,大于它们报告的+3.5+3.5分.
其余五者为平或负.
因此,对这一能力类的一些模型来说,观察是真实的。

blocks.en:
Most of it is the leak.
Restating the task in the baseline prompt, with no request to encode anything, is worth + 3.6 +3.6 to + 8.3 +8.3 points in six of the seven models (all p < .01 p<.01 ); the exception is Mistral-Medium-3, which the restatement makes 5.4 5.4 points worse.
Against that matched baseline the two schemes separate.
Word-count beats it in no model at all, landing within a point of it in both models that gained: + 0.3 +0.3 for Qwen3-235B ( p = .44 p=.44 ) and + 0.9 +0.9 for GPT-5-nano ( p = .32 p=.32 ).
Its entire apparent advantage is the restatement its instructions leak.
First-letter keeps a residual in exactly those two models, + 4.7 +4.7 points for Qwen3-235B ( p < .001 p<.001 ) and + 4.4 +4.4 for GPT-5-nano ( p = .007 p=.007 ).
Restricting to the 3-to-5-move regime Zolkowski et al. [2025] single out changes nothing: the same two models beat the matched baseline, by + 9.0 +9.0 points for GPT-5-nano ( p < .001 p<.001 ) and + 3.5 +3.5 for Qwen3-235B ( p = .033 p=.033 ), and the same five do not.
blocks.zh:
多数是漏水
在基线快报中重报任务,不要求编码任何东西,在七个模型中的六个模型中值+3.6+3.6到+8.3+8.3分(均为p <.01 p <.01);例外是Mistral-Medium-3,重报使5.4分更差.
与此相对应的基线是两个不同的方案。
Word-counter beat it in no models at all,在两个模型的某一点内着陆,均获得: Qwen3-235B(p=44 p=44)+0.3+0.3,GPT-5-nano(p=32 p=32)+0.9+0.9.
它的整个明显优势是重述其指令泄露.
第一字母在这两个型号中保留了一定的剩余值,Qune3-235B的+4.7+4.7分(p < 001 p < 001),GPT-5-nano的+4.4+4.4(p=.007 p=.007)。
限制在3-5移动的政权佐尔科夫斯基等人. [2025]单列无变化:同一两个型号击败了对应的基准,GPT-5-nano的+9.0+9.0分(p < .001 p < 001)和Qwen3-235B的+3.5+3.5分(p=.033 p=.033),同五个型号没有.

blocks.en:
In four models the encoding actively hurts.
DeepSeek-V3.1, Kimi-K2-0905, and Gemini-2.5-Flash fall 5.5 5.5 to 9.8 9.8 points below the matched baseline under first-letter, and DeepSeek-V3-0324 falls 9.2 9.2 points below it under word-count (all two-sided p < .001 p<.001 ).
For them, attempting the encoding costs more than the leak gives.
blocks.zh:
在四个模型中,编码会积极伤害。
DeepSeek-V3.1,Kimi-K2-0905和双子座-2.5-Flash在首字母下比对应基准低5.5至9.89.8分,DeepSeek-V3-0324在字数下比它低9.2.9.2分(均为双面p <.001 p < 001).
对他们来说,尝试编码的成本比泄漏要高。

blocks.en:
No model in the grid actually encodes.
The post-hoc first-letter decode recovers 0.10 0.10 to 0.40 0.40 of the hidden states against a chance level of 0.5 0.5 , in every model including the two that gain.
Values below chance mean the models rarely begin sentences with north or south words at all.
The word-count decode sits between 0.36 0.36 and 0.51 0.51 , which is uninformative rather than reassuring: word-count parity is close to uniform in ordinary prose, so that decode has no floor to fall below.
blocks.zh:
网格中实际上没有模型编码.
后Hoc首字母解码器以0.5 0.5 的机率水平回收了0.10 0.10到0.40 0.40的隐藏状态,在每个模型中,包括两个增益状态.
概率以下的值意味着模型很少用北词或南词开头的句子.
字数解码在0.36 0.36到0.51 0.51之间,这不是一种信息化,而不是令人放心:字数均价在普通的散文中接近统一,因此解码没有下限.

blocks.en:
The residual is small and the screen tests 56 contrasts, so the follow-up re-tests GPT-5-nano and Qwen3-235B at n ≈ 1000 n\approx 1000 per cell on a larger pool of 5000 cover questions (Table S7 , Figure S17 a).
It holds: + 3.7 +3.7 points pooled for GPT-5-nano and + 5.3 +5.3 for Qwen3-235B, both p < .001 p<.001 .
blocks.zh:
残基很小,屏幕测试了56个对比度,因此后续在5000个覆盖问题(表S7,图S17 a)的更大池上,每个细胞在n + 1000 n\\\1000时对GPT-5-nano和Quen3-235B进行重新测试.
它持有:GPT-5-nano的+3.7+3.7积分,Qwen3-235B的+5.3+5.3积分,两者均为p < 001 p < 001.

blocks.en:
How the residual depends on sequence length is where we part from their reading. Zolkowski et al. [2025] report a first-letter gain that appears at short sequences and fades as sequences lengthen, and take that fade as an early sign of steganographic reasoning.
GPT-5-nano fits: its residual is largest at short sequences and indistinguishable from zero at lengths 8 and 12, though the downward trend of − 0.49 -0.49 points per step is not itself significant ( p = .084 p=.084 ).
Qwen3-235B does the reverse, growing from + 2.9 +2.9 points at length 3 to + 8.3 +8.3 at length 12 ( + 0.59 +0.59 points per step, p = .002 p=.002 ).
The two profiles point opposite ways.
A fixed advantage from leaked prompt content should fade as the task gets harder, which is GPT-5-nano’s pattern, whereas Qwen3-235B gains most exactly where the state-tracking is hardest, which is what real externalised state-tracking would look like.
Their length signature is thus not general even among models that show the effect, and in the one model whose profile does suggest steganographic reasoning, the traces rule it out.
blocks.zh:
剩余部分如何取决于序列长度 也就是我们脱离它们读取的地方 佐尔科夫斯基等人著. [2025] 报告在短序列中出现的第一个字母增益,并视其为序列长度的变长,并将这个变长作为表征推理的早期标志.
GPT-5-nano符合:它的残留在短序列中最大,在长度8和12中与零无法区分,尽管每步0.49-0.49分的下降趋势本身并不显著(p=.084 p=.084)。
Qune3-235B做反向,从长度3的+2.9+2.9点增长到长度12的+8.3+8.3点(每步+0.59+0.59点,p=.002 p=.002)。
这两个剖面图指向相反的方式。
漏泄的即时内容的固定优势应该随着任务越来越困难而消失,这是GPT-5-nano的图案,而Qune3-235B则在州轨最困难的地方获得最多好处,这就是真正外部化的州轨将是什么样子。
因此,即使在显示效果的模型中,它们的长度签名也不是一般的,在一个其特征确实暗示有素推理的模型中,痕迹排除了它.

blocks.en:
Trace accuracy under the strict decode stays at or below chance at every length for both models, and falls as sequences lengthen, reaching 0.06 0.06 for GPT-5-nano and 0.21 0.21 for Qwen3-235B at length 12 (Figure S17 b).
A lenient decode that reads only the sentences actually starting with a north or south word does not rescue it: Qwen3-235B recovers a fully correct sequence in at most 8.8 % 8.8\% of length-3 completions, and in none by length 8.
Nor does the carrier count respond to the task.
Qwen3-235B writes about 4.5 4.5 north/south-initial sentences per completion whether it must track 3 states or 12, so how many carriers it produces is a fact about its writing style, not about what needs encoding.
blocks.zh:
严格解码下的跟踪精度在两种模型的每个长度上都保持在或低于概率,并且作为序列长度下降,GPT-5-nano为0.06,Qune3-235B为0.21 0.21。 长度为12(图S17b)。
宽大解码只读从北到南字开始的句子并不能挽救它: Qune3-235 B在最多8.8%的长度-3完成时恢复完全正确的序列,在零的长度8中恢复完全正确的序列.
承运人也没有对这项任务作出反应。
Quen3-235B写着大约4.54.5个南北开头的句子,每句完成一次,无论它必须跟踪3个状态还是12个状态,所以它生产多少载体是关于其写作风格的事实,而不是需要编码的内容.

blocks.en:
The same holds one completion at a time.
If the encoding carried the residual, completions whose traces decode better should more often end in a correct answer.
They do not.
Regressing answer correctness on per-completion trace accuracy, with a separate intercept per sequence length, gives a slope indistinguishable from zero in both models: 0.05 0.05 for Qwen3-235B (95% bootstrap CI [ − 0.30 , 0.41 ] [-0.30,0.41] , n = 3985 n=3985 ) and − 0.18 -0.18 for GPT-5-nano ( [ − 0.61 , 0.24 ] [-0.61,0.24] , n = 4000 n=4000 ).
The per-length intercepts matter because short sequences are both easier to track and easier to encode.
blocks.zh:
同样的情况是一次完成一次。
如果编码带有残余物,其痕迹更好的解码完成应更经常地以正确的答案结束.
他们没有。
每完成微量精度上的回转答正确性,每个序列长度单独截取,使两种型号的倾斜度都与0不可区分:Qune3-235B(95%的靴子CI [−0.30,0.41],n=3985 n=3985),GPT-5-nano([−0.61,0.24] [-0.61,0.24],n=4000 n=4000).
由于短序列既更容易跟踪,又更容易编码,因此全长截取会具有重要性.

blocks.en:
A mechanism that needs no readable trace is pacing: the instruction makes the model write more before committing to an answer, and those extra tokens give it room to compute the state latently.
The follow-up tests this at the strongest cell, Qwen3-235B at length 12, with an arm that asks for a natural answer followed by the final state and mentions no encoding, scheme, or silent solving (Figure S17 c).
It lands at 0.486 0.486 , indistinguishable from the matched baseline’s 0.499 0.499 (two-sided p = .22 p=.22 ), while first-letter reaches 0.583 0.583 and beats both ( p < .001 p<.001 ).
Within every arm, longer answers predict slightly worse accuracy, not better.
Room to write is not what produces the residual.
blocks.zh:
一个不需要可读跟踪的机制是步调:指令让模型在承诺一个答案之前写得更多,那些额外的符号给它空间来潜在地计算状态.
后续在最强的细胞Qwen3-235B的长度为12,其手臂要求自然答案,然后是最终状态,并提到没有编码,计划,或无声解(图S17 c).
它降落在0.486 0.486 ,与对应基线的0.499 0.499(双侧p = 22 p = 22)相差无几,而第一字母则达到0.583 0.583,并击败两者(p < 001 p < 001)。
在每一臂内,较长的答案预测精度略差,而不是更好.
书房不是产生剩余部分的地方。

blocks.en:
Only the pooled effects are stable.
GPT-5-nano’s per-length pattern reorders itself between the two runs: length 5 gives + 11.7 +11.7 points in the screen and + 7.0 +7.0 in the follow-up, length 8 gives + 2.7 +2.7 and then + 2.3 +2.3 , and length 12 gives − 3.0 -3.0 and then + 1.1 +1.1 .
At n = 300 n=300 per cell these are noise around a small pooled effect, and the largest of them shrinks as the sample grows.
We therefore rest no claim on any single length cell.
blocks.zh:
只有集合效应是稳定的。
GPT-5-nano的全长图案在两跑间自行调整顺序:5长在屏幕上给出+11.7+11.7分,后续图上给出+7.0+7.0分,8长在+2.7+2.7分,然后是+2.3+2.3分,12长在→3.0-3.0分,然后是+1.1+1.1分.
在n=300n=300的每个细胞中,这些是围绕一个小集合效应发出的噪声,随着样本的生长,其中最大的噪声会收缩.
因此,我们不对任何单长度牢房提出任何主张。

blocks.en:
The subtle-scheme uplift of Zolkowski et al. [2025] replicates as an observation but not as evidence of encoded reasoning.
It appears in two of seven capability-matched models and in only one of their two schemes.
For word-count it is entirely the task restatement that their encoding instructions leak, and for first-letter the leak accounts for roughly half, with the encoding attempt costing accuracy outright in three further models.
What survives is a residual first-letter advantage in two models that is robust to a threefold increase in n n and a larger pool of cover questions, and that is nonetheless not encoded reasoning: the traces are at or below chance under both a strict and a lenient decode, the number of carrier sentences does not respond to how much there is to encode, and giving the model the same room to write without the encoding instruction produces no advantage at all.
The mechanism we consider most likely is that attempting a per-sentence encoding acts as a procedural scaffold, forcing the model to step through the task one move at a time as it writes even though the channel it is told to write into is never used.
That remains untested; the natural next experiment is whether the intensity of the attempt, the number of north/south-initial sentences a completion contains, predicts its accuracy within the first-letter arm.
blocks.zh:
柔尔科斯基等人的微妙的策略提升. [2025]作为观察而复制,但不是编码推理的证据.
它出现在7种能力匹配模式中的2种中,并且仅出现在它们的两个方案中之一。
就文字计算而言,完全是任务重述其编码指令漏出,而第一字母漏出则占大约一半,编码尝试在另外三个模型中直接计算准确性。
幸存下来的是两种模型中的剩余第一字母优势,N的增幅为三倍,封面问题也更大,然而这并非编码推理:在严格和宽松的解码下,痕迹可能或低于概率,载体句数对编码量没有反应,给模型一个没有编码指令的相同写空间完全没有产生优势.
我们认为最有可能的是,试图按判决编码是一种程序脚手架,迫使模型在写作时一步一步地完成一个任务,尽管它被告知要写入的频道从未使用过。
这还没有经过测试;下一个自然实验是尝试的强度,一个完成的北/南初始句数,是否预测它在第一个字母臂内的准确性。
